Specification: This module is a TLC support module for model checking the LiveInternalMemory specification. It defines replacement operators for the constant operators Send, Reply, and InitMemInt so that TLC can instantiate them with concrete behaviors and initial internal-memory values. It also defines a liveness formula about processors always eventually being busy, and a concrete PostCondition describing a counterexample trace and state set using records, tuples, and function-like expressions.
